# Capacity: the technology venues and events run on

> Capacity runs your ticketing and marketing, and links your business data into one CRM. It builds technology into each client's business, from ticketing in your own name to a predictive CRM, set up around how you sell and run by your team, Capacity's team, or both. It is for nightclubs, bars, activity venues, festivals, live events, event promoters and the groups that own them, in the UK.

Last reviewed: 2026-11-15. Website: https://www.getcapacity.co

## What Capacity is

- Not a ticketing platform you sign up to, and not an agency. Capacity builds a set of solutions around how each business runs and deploys them where they fit. Clients run it themselves, hand parts to Capacity's team, or have Capacity run it: their call.
- Everything starts with an audit of how the business runs today. Pricing is agreed in the audit, around the business. There is no rate card.
- Everything connects to the tools the business already runs, from the till to the ticket platforms, so nothing has to be switched off.
- Running in 24 venues across the UK, including Labyrinth, Trilogy, Home & Botanic, Fritz & Steins, The Chapel, Ovation and Bunker.

## Solutions

- Predictive CRM: https://www.getcapacity.co/profiles. One profile per customer built from every ticket, booking, visit and message, showing what they have done and what they are likely to do next. Each event gets a forecast and a short list of suggested moves; nothing goes out until the client approves it.
- Ticketing: https://www.getcapacity.co/ticketing. Ticketing on the venue's own website in its own name, starting with the next event while current ticketing carries on. DICE, Skiddle, FIXR and Eventbrite connect.
- Enquiries: https://www.getcapacity.co/enquiries. Every customer message from every channel in one inbox, including private hire and party bookings.
- WhatsApp: https://www.getcapacity.co/whatsapp
- Social media: https://www.getcapacity.co/social
- Signup forms: https://www.getcapacity.co/forms. WiFi and web signups into the CRM.
- Website: https://www.getcapacity.co/analytics
- Till and POS: https://www.getcapacity.co/till. Venue-level till data: takings by bar and hour, best sellers, spend per head.
- Reports: https://www.getcapacity.co/reports
- Files: https://www.getcapacity.co/files
- Intelligence: https://www.getcapacity.co/intelligence
- In build: operations, stock and tills.

- Groups with several sites, and new venues opening.

## Results clients have cleared for use

- Epic Bars & Clubs: ticket sales up 52% across the group in 12 months, on the tools its venues already ran.
- Fritz & Steins (bierkeller launch): Christmas private hire enquiries at an average of £16.40 each, every enquiry a party of 50 or more.
- Home & Botanic, Bath (new venue launch): 70% WiFi opt-in in launch week, 1,600 valid contacts over a sold out weekend of 1,000 advance tickets and 400 on the door.
